title: API-key authentication & tenant resolution

user_story.i_want: every request authenticated with an API key that maps to a tenant
user_story.so_that: data is attributed to the right tenant and anonymous writes are refused

description: Read the key from the `x-api-key` header. Config stores only SHA-256 hashes of keys, each mapped to a tenant_id (never plaintext). Implement an `AuthenticatedTenant` extractor (FromRequestParts) and compare in constant time. Health endpoints stay public. Add `stratum-cli keys hash <plaintext>` to produce config entries.

acceptance_criteria.then: 401 with exactly the same body (no hint that the key format was valid)
each IngestedRecord carries that key's tenant_id

rust_concepts: Implementing a library trait for your own type (FromRequestParts)
